author: codex

patch.value: Documented TOON record paths fail staging because the record codec accepts JSON only

The README's primary init example configures .agents/pm/**/*.toon as first-class records, but staging a real pm-initialized tracker calls the JSON-only record decoder and aborts with record payload is not valid JSON. This prevents pm-vcs from using pm's native item format as the structured merge primitive it advertises.

A real installed-CLI test stages native TOON item and history data through the registered extension; canonical TOON decoding and encoding preserve all supported pm fields; per-field merge handles concurrent PM item edits; JSON record paths remain compatible; README examples are executable.
Initialize a fresh pm workspace; install pm-vcs; run pm vcs init with record path .agents/pm/**/*.toon; create a Task with pm; run pm vcs add.
Native PM TOON items stage as record objects and later merge per field without losing TOON semantics or history.
pm vcs add aborts with Record payload is not valid JSON.
